name: Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
text:
या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता
या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा या श्वेतपद्मासना ।
या ब्रह्माच्युतशङ्करप्रभृतिभिर्देवैः सदा वन्दिता
सा मां पातु सरस्वती भगवती निःशेषजाड्यापहा ॥
meaning: She who is radiant like jasmine, the moon and snow, dressed in white, holding the veena and seated on a white lotus; who is always honoured by Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the gods: may that Saraswati protect me and remove every dullness.
purpose: A descriptive invocation of Saraswati’s beauty and her association with knowledge and the arts.
supports: Creative confidence; learning; music; writing; clear expression.
note: The library gives the opening lines; the client list has the whole verse, given here.
